name: FA_ASSET_HISTORY
description: FA_ASSET_HISTORY contains information about asset category change, capitalizations, unit adjustments, and partial unit retirements. When you initially add an asset, Oracle Fusion Assets inserts one row into the table and this becomes the active row for the asset. When you perform category change or unit adjustment for an asset, Oracle Fusion Assets marks this row as obsolete and inserts a new row. If you either reclassify an asset or change its asset type in the period in which you added the asset, Oracle Fusion Assets simply updates the row, since the transaction has no financial impact. At any point in time, there is only one active row in the table for an asset, and you can always identify it because it is the only one whose DATE_INEFFECTIVE is NULL.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset category.

columns.name: ASSET_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the asset allowed in Oracle Fusion Assets. The asset types allowed are Capitalized, Construction-in-Process, Expensed, and Group.

columns.name: UNITS
columns.description: Total number of units for the asset.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID_IN
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction that created the row.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID_OUT
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction that terminated the row.

columns.name: DATE_EFFECTIVE
columns.description: Date when the row became effective.

columns.name: DATE_INEFFECTIVE
columns.description: Date when the row became inactive.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The name of the asset book.
